title: Instructions
subtitle: The text this realm's agents get with their instructions on this computer, and its on/off.
allRealms.title: Choose one realm
allRealms.body: Each realm has its own instructions. Pick a realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square) to see and change them.
old.title: Instructions can't be shown for this realm yet
old.body: Instructions are kept per realm, and this computer's agent can't read a realm's instructions yet. Update the agent to see and change them here.
switch.label: Give agents these instructions
effect.given: On. This text is added whenever an agent's instructions are built, unless the chat's or agent's prompt settings leave it out.
effect.off: Off. Instructions built from now on leave this text out. The text is kept.
effect.blank: No text written. Instructions built from now on get nothing from here.
text.label: Instructions text
effect.running: A chat picks up a change at its next turn; a helper or workflow step already running keeps the version it started with.
refreshFailed: We couldn't read the instructions again ({{code}}). What you see is from the last read, and your text is unchanged.
conflict: These instructions changed since you opened them, so nothing was saved. Your text and switch are still here.
conflict.theirsFailed: We couldn't read the instructions to compare ({{code}}). Try again.
diff.title: Saving yours over theirs would change them like this
overridden.text: This realm's settings.local.json on this computer sets the text, and it wins over this change, so nothing was saved. Remove agent_instructions from that file, or save the text it sets.
overridden.enabled: This realm's settings.local.json on this computer sets on or off, and it wins over this change, so nothing was saved. Remove agent_instructions from that file, or save the on/off it sets.
overridden.both: This realm's settings.local.json on this computer sets the text and on/off, and it wins over this change, so nothing was saved. Remove agent_instructions from that file to change them here.
overridden.unknown: This realm's settings.local.json on this computer sets these instructions, and it wins over this change, so nothing was saved.
refused: The agent didn't save this, so nothing was written ({{code}}).
refused.unsent: The save wasn't sent, so nothing was written ({{code}}).
unsure: The answer to your save didn't arrive. It may have been saved. We have not sent it again.
unsure.failed: We couldn't read the instructions to check. Try again.
unsure.same: They look the same as before your save. That doesn't show the save didn't happen: it may still land.
unsure.changed: They are different now, but not what you saved. That doesn't show what happened to your save: it may have landed before another change, or may still land.
abandon.title: Stop tracking this save?
abandon.body: We could not tell whether your save went through, and we have not sent it again. If you stop here it may still land later. Your text stays here, and your next Save is checked against the instructions as you first read them: if anything changed since, your earlier save included, nothing is written and you can compare.
reload.title: Drop your changes?
reload.body: Your unsaved text and switch are replaced by the instructions as they are now. This can't be undone.
leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to the instructions aren't saved yet. They stay here while the Hub is open: come back to save them. A reload or sign-out loses them.
leave.body.unsure: A save of the instructions may or may not have gone through, and we haven't checked. It stays here while the Hub is open: come back to check it.
held.loss_one: An instructions change you haven't seen saved stays while you switch realm, and is lost if you sign out.
held.loss_other: {{count}} instructions changes you haven't seen saved stay while you switch realm, and are lost if you sign out.
